title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on John 21: the catch of fish at the sea of Tiberias, breakfast on the beach, and Jesus' three questions to Peter.

questions.text: Where did Jesus reveal himself again to the disciples?
questions.explanation: John 21:1 says Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias.

questions.text: What did the disciples catch that night after Peter said he was going fishing?
questions.explanation: They went out and entered the boat, and that night they caught nothing.

answers.text: So much that the net tore

questions.text: What did Jesus tell them to do from the beach?
questions.explanation: He told them to cast the net on the right side of the boat, and they would find some.

answers.text: Row back to the shore and wait
Wait until the next night to fish
Cast the net on the right side of the boat
Leave the net and follow him

questions.text: Who said to Peter, "It's the Lord!"?
questions.explanation: That disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It's the Lord!"

answers.text: One of the sons of Zebedee

questions.text: What did they see when they got out on the land?
questions.explanation: They saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

answers.text: A fire of coals with fish and bread on it
An empty beach and their nets
A table set in a house
Jesus still standing in the water

questions.text: How many great fish did Peter draw to land in the net?
questions.explanation: Simon Peter drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish, and the net was not torn.

questions.text: What did Jesus say to the disciples once they had come ashore?
questions.explanation: Jesus said to them, "Come and eat breakfast!" and none of them dared ask who he was.

questions.text: What did Jesus tell Peter to do after his first answer about loving him?
questions.explanation: After Peter said he had affection for him, Jesus said to him, "Feed my lambs."

questions.text: Why was Peter grieved during this conversation?
questions.explanation: Peter was grieved because Jesus asked him the third time whether he had affection for him.

answers.text: Because the other disciples heard it
Because Jesus asked him a third time
Because he had caught no fish
Because Jesus was about to leave

questions.text: What did Jesus say would happen to Peter when he is old?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that when Peter is old he will stretch out his hands, and another will dress him and carry him where he does not want to go.

answers.text: He would dress himself and walk where he wanted
He would stay until Jesus came again
Another would dress him and carry him away
He would be brought back to the sea
